items.title: Your best AX fixes are hiding in agent trajectories
items.summary: All five agent runs produced a working script, and nothing in the eval score looked wrong. The trajectories told a different story. Every run read a DLL as raw bytes to find plugin names, and three scripts would quietly reroute a CI runner's network traffic. Here are the patterns to look for in your own agents' trajectories, and what to change in your product when you find them.The post Your best AX fixes are hiding in agent trajectories appeared first on Microsoft for Developers.
